help: The live address for the OurMynd app. The app reads this file at launch and uses the address in it, so moving the app to another server is an edit here plus a publish - no new build, no App Review. One server is listed at a time. ourmynd-server and ourmynd-server-3bvh share one Supabase database, so neither holds data the other cannot see; what they do NOT share is JWT_SECRET, because render.yaml generates one per service. A token from one is rejected by the other, so listing both would sign everybody out the moment a probe failed over - which is why only one is here. Always suspend the one not listed, or status checks keep waking it and billing hours. To switch, put the other address in both fields and publish; the app already trusts it, so no release is needed. Copy JWT_SECRET between the two services first and the switch costs nobody their session. The app only accepts addresses it trusts (lib/core/services/server_directory.dart), so editing this file cannot send anybody's session somewhere new. Source of truth: deploy/servers.json in the app repo.
